d:
Step into the 90s nostalgia with the timeless romantic love song 'Jaati Hoon Main' from the blockbuster movie 'Karan Arjun,' starring Shah Rukh Khan and Kajol. Let the magical voices of Kumar Sanu and Alka Yagnik serenade you in this iconic melody. Relive the era of romance and blockbuster hits as you get lost in the chemistry of SRK and Kajol.
Song Credits:
Singer(s): Kumar Sanu, Alka Yagnik
Music Director: Rajesh Roshan
Lyricist: Indeevar
Movie Cast & Crew:
Producer: Rakesh Roshan
Director: Rakesh Roshan
